**Prerequisites (listed separately).**

1. `problem: fulfill_ext_shortage_claim_units`, `form: state`, policy_source "The units approved on an inbound shortage case are not fixed until the units claimed on that case equal the claimable shortage of its shipment line."
   - Verbatim in the blocked hub "Decisions on FBN Inbound-Shortage Reimbursement Cases", § Conditions on the decision, bullet 1; same-form restatement in the same doc ("Restated against the records: while the units claimed … differ from the claimable shortage of its shipment line, its approved units are not yet fixed"). Connective "not … until", state form, hard-gate strength intact.
   - In no other policy's document. Resolution basis: sentence + correction doc ("The claimable shortage of a shipment line is the figure a seller enters as the units claimed when correcting their own open inbound-shortage case") + records (`units_claimed: 38`; claimable 26; line receipt 42 days old, inside the correction period).
2. `problem: fulfill_ext_damaged_case_approval`, `form: state`, policy_source "An inbound shortage case is decided only after no warehouse-damage case of the same SKU opened before it still stands submitted."
   - Verbatim in the same hub, bullet 2; same-form restatement ("while any warehouse-damage case of the same SKU, opened before the inbound-shortage case, still stands submitted, the inbound-shortage case is not decided") and a hypothetical status table that only reads the state (none / approved / submitted / opened after) without naming any action, tool or performer. Connective "only after", state form, strength intact.
   - In no other policy's document. Resolution basis: sentence + damage decision doc ("The case, open with status submitted until it is decided, becomes **approved**.") + records (damage case e2c9c605…, WOG-TREK-POLE-PAIR, `submitted`, created 2026-09-03 < 2026-09-14).
   - The edge's `effect` (one more approved case moving the verification holdback to the waived tier) is entailed, not written: the inbound verification holdback document counts approved cases by status inside 12 months, and the damage case is approved by the time the shortage case is decided. Nothing in the corpus states this consequence, correctly.
- `condition`, `resolved_by`, `fallback_reason` have no home in any document.
